{"consolidated_memory":"## Wrong Environment in platform/config/loader.py — Three Separate Incidents

All three occasions involve the same underlying problem area (platform/config/loader.py) and exhibit the same signal: a production endpoint in a staging process. Common reproduction: boot the service with an unset profile variable. Stack: Python. Covering test: tests/platform/test_config_loader.py.

### Incident 1: [2026-01-07] Non-ASCII Names Triggering Error (c022-e0)
- **Trigger**: Records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Root cause**: Error swallowed by a bare except clause
- **Fix**: Narrowed the exception handler to let the failure propagate (PR #2692 on branch fix/wrong-environment-1)
- **Result**: Job finished in 29 minutes instead of 3 hours

### Incident 2: [2026-06-13] Jobs Crossing Midnight Boundary (c022-e2)
- **Trigger**: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- **Root cause**: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- **Fix**: Added the composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #8949 on branch fix/wrong-environment-3)
- **Result**: Flaky test went from 23 failures per hundred runs to zero

### Incident 3: [2026-08-23] Post-Fleet Restart Issue (c022-e3)
- **Trigger**: Appeared only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- **Root cause**: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- **Fix**: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #9216 on branch fix/wrong-environment-4)
- **Result**: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 96 days running"}
